title: L. Better local ML sentiment
description: Purpose: upgrade the local ML sentiment backend from the binary SST-2 head to a 3-class model with a real neutral class, and survey/benchmark other small offline candidates on BlackbookM1. Done when: at least 3 local candidates benchmarked (held-out gold accuracy, confusion matrix, throughput, model size, aggregate-only real-corpus agreement vs VADER), a winner wired into --sentiment-backend with VADER kept as fallback, and tests/docs updated. Privacy invariants unchanged: local only, counts/aggregates only in any persisted output, no message text.
